author: CathieDWood
text: Each Starship launch could generate $1 billion in revenue. Elon is aiming for 10,000 flights per year, or  $10 trillion in Starship revenues, by 2030. If SpaceX achieves this goal, its $1.75 trillion IPO will be considered, in hindsight, a deep value opportunity!
